description.value: The 626 is a multi-concept eatery in Masset on Haida Gwaii, built around fresh locally-caught halibut fish and chips but also serving handmade sourdough pizza, burgers, ice cream in 25 flavours, and craft cocktails from a novelty automated cocktail machine. What began as a food truck has grown into a full restaurant with a Haida Art Gallery showcasing local indigenous artists. Located on Main Street across from the Delmas Co-op, it is a distinctive culinary destination at the north end of Haida Gwaii.
